core.title: Keep every train-level acceptance well-formed
core.given: A user/system flow plan artifact (a user/system flow file, wherever the profile's plan-item pattern places user/system flow artifacts, flat or subject-nested) declares the optional acceptances[] block (DESIRED OUTCOME acceptance shape); each entry contributes a derived repo rule via rule binding.
core.when: The planner authors, edits or keeps a train-level acceptance that is checked at CONFIRM.
core.then: Every train-level acceptance must be well-formed: identity.urn matches the acceptance URN grammar (acc:<user-system-flow-id>:<slug>), identity.purpose is populated, identity.phase is one of RED|GREEN|SMOKE|REFACTOR, and the block is measurable via harness.type OR signal.metric together with signal.threshold.
prefer: Satisfy all four constraints: identity.urn matches the acc grammar (acc:<user-system-flow-id>:<slug>); identity.purpose populated (becomes the derived rule's description); identity.phase in RED|GREEN|SMOKE|REFACTOR; measurable via harness.type OR signal.metric+signal.threshold.

Copy the exemplar: identity {urn: acc:user-system-flow:self-compliance:validate-lifecycle:idempotent-on-retry, id: AC-SMOKE-001, purpose: 'Re-running the user/system flow with the same idempotency key produces no duplicate side effects', phase: SMOKE}, harness {type: e2e}, signal {metric: duplicate_side_effects_on_retry, threshold: 0}.
Let the rule id derive: acc:<user-system-flow-id>:<slug> -> repo.<user-system-flow-id>.acc-<slug>.
avoid: id: at acceptance-block top level (the rule id derives mechanically from the URN).

disposition: set by hand anywhere in the repository's rule-binding files (the declaration files from which rule binding derives repo rules; binding sets every derived repo rule's disposition to strict).
Retired URN schemes or examples failing the acc grammar / the user/system flow schema's acceptance shape.
signal.metric without signal.threshold (or vice versa) as sole measurability.
core.why: Each acceptance becomes a derived repo rule that rule binding sets to strict; a bad URN, missing purpose/phase or unmeasurable block yields an unbindable or meaningless rule, so a confirm-blocking check verifies well-formedness.
evidence: The well-formedness check passes at CONFIRM (confirm-blocking) over every selected user/system flow acceptance.
On failure the check reports the user/system flow artifact, the acceptance's URN, the failed constraint, and detail.
The authorable exemplar itself satisfies the acceptance URN grammar, parses as a valid parent user/system flow artifact, and validates against the user/system flow schema's acceptance definition.
Every constraint of the check has a fault-injection test; a clean run over an empty selection (no user/system flows with acceptances) proves nothing.
verification: A well-formedness check over user/system flow plan artifacts runs at the CONFIRM phase and is confirm-blocking (it blocks the confirm on any finding).
Per-rule enforcement: severity 3, disposition strict — the rule fails on every finding; no advisory mode, no ratchet baseline.

Selection is by presence of an acceptances[] block in a user/system flow plan artifact (the artifacts matched by the profile's plan-item pattern), not by change: existing unchanged blocks are selected too; user/system flow plan artifacts without the block are out of scope (the block is optional), and non-user/system-flow acceptance blocks (e.g. Desired-outcome-level acceptances outside the user/system flow artifacts) are not selected.
Traversal: user/system flow plan artifact -> acceptances[] -> identity / harness / signal fields.

Constraints checked: identity.urn matches the acceptance URN grammar (the acc grammar, train-acceptance shape); identity.purpose populated (it becomes the derived rule's description); identity.phase populated (RED|GREEN|SMOKE|REFACTOR); EITHER harness.type OR (signal.metric AND signal.threshold) populated (measurability).

Excluded by this check: id at the acceptance-block top level (the rule id derives mechanically from the URN) and disposition set anywhere in the repository's rule-binding files (rule binding sets the derived repo rule's disposition to strict, so the check excludes the field rather than validating it).
On failure the check reports the user/system flow artifact, the acceptance URN, the failed constraint, and detail.
Every constraint of the check has a fault-injection test; a clean run over an empty selection (no user/system flow artifacts carrying acceptances) proves nothing.

The authorable exemplar is itself verified to satisfy the acceptance URN grammar, parse as a valid parent user/system flow artifact, and validate against the user/system flow schema's acceptance definition.

neutralityNotes: The acceptances[] block shape (identity/harness/signal fields), the phases RED|GREEN|SMOKE|REFACTOR and CONFIRM, the acc URN scheme and the repo-rule id derivation are treated as method-level (DESIRED_OUTCOME/ATDD) vocabulary, not stack specifics, so they stay in the core; the concrete grammar the check enforces is additionally supplied via urn.acceptance, and the user/system flow artifact location comes from layout.plan_item (the existing plan-artifact path key; no new key needed). The authorable exemplar (prefer[1]) contains no stack constructs and is kept verbatim for losslessness — bun.json itself remains the delivered reference example. What could not be made neutral: this rule's validator/test/family/template/variant ids and failure-evidence field names (bunOnly, per the closed not-profile-keys list), the walker module path and spec-version citations (§3.3, §4.3, §4.4, spec v12 — realization citations, kept in bun.json only), and the exemplar's concrete typed-train parser machinery (the general obligations — parse as a valid parent user/system flow artifact and validate against the user/system flow schema's acceptance definition — are kept in the core). 'anywhere in repo YAML' is expressed as 'anywhere in the repository's rule-binding files', a profile-backed scope (idiom.convention_graph#rule_binding_files, for Bun: every YAML file in the repository) so the restriction keeps its exact artifact-format scope under instantiation without the core naming a file format and without equating all repository artifacts with repository YAML; the key is proposed because no existing vocabulary key names the repository's declaration-format file set (suffix.plan_artifact covers only plan artifacts).
